name: The Monogrammed Sash
objectiveText: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner. Monogrammed Sash (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: Um, quest description above states: "Ends with Captain Hecklebury Smotts".  It really is best to read the quest description before posting for help...

Turning this quest into Captain Hecklebury Smotts gives you a follow up quest "The Captain's Cutlass". You then speak to Sprogger (standing next to the captain) who gives you the quest "Facing Negolash". Once you complete that quest you receive Smott's Compass.
Its a drop from Mekrosh the lvl 50 Elite located on the island immediately south of BB. Try and do him with a few mates will ya? :)
replies:
dropped him with my 55 druid while waiting for the boat. Swam out to see what that island was about and there he was. I know a mob 5 levels down (even elite) isn't that hard but I was still expecting better loot than this sash and some silver!

at least the quest reward was 2100xp, so I can't complain. Not bad for 2 short swims and a few minutes fighting.

[just swim back to BB and go for the yellow dot on your mini-map. He's near the boat to Ratchet landing place.]

comments.body: It's in Booty Bay HS is the captain on the dock by the boat. don't remember exact name.

Rumors abound about his spawn time.  Some say 24 hours.  Some say it might be trigged by another quest.  Put your thoughts here and combined we might figure it out.

This quest is prerequisite to the Negolash quest which drops the nice compass.

I had seen him yell a few time when waiting for the boat in BB. So I finaly decided to swim over and see. (cloth)That begun a quest, basicly u have to give the sash to smotts, who stands by the boat. I got like 13 silver, probly could have sold the sash to a vendor for more -.-

replies: Has about 9600 HP. Damage per hit was 450 against my lvl 60 rogue with 1600 armor, so he is not that easy to defeat with a melee class.

Level 47 SL lock, took him down with 14 HP left.
Forgot to activate Soul Link before the battle though :P Used my feldoggy, a healthstone and a 700-900 health potion. Fear kiting wins :)

I was a 54 warrior when I took him on.

Bow shot, swim towards dock.  Hamstring, swim towards dock.  Once a few guards are aggro'd on him, it's easy.

Had to bandage, but since the guards throw nets over him repeately, it's easy to find the time.

Kinda ticks people off when you solo him because he can only be killed 365 times a year or so...hahaha.
Booyah! I killed it with my lvl 47 warlock alone :DD My hands are still shaking :D
Just soloed him with level 50 Palladin.Had to use both of my bubbles and i runcloth bandages. Other than that--easy

Soloed this guy as a lvl 48 Frost Mage with lvl 46 skillset, version of wow classic 1.13.4. It took two tries, but I did kill him with full hp. I had to use most of my skills, Cold Snap, Evocation, my mana gem, but I did not need to use Iceblock. Coldsnap was used so I got more use out of Frost Nova. Its doable, and not impossible. He is kitable and is not immune to chilled effect. Good luck fellow mages that want to try this on for size!
